name: Navidrome Wrapped
author: Navidrome Wrapped contributors
description: Your year in music, Spotify Wrapped style. Builds each user's yearly listening stats from Navidrome's own scrobble history, creates a 'Wrapped · Top Songs' playlist that shows up in every Subsonic client, and writes an animated story page per user.

year.title: Year
year.description: Year to wrap. 0 = automatic (the current year, or last year when run in January).

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used for year boundaries, the listening clock and daily streaks (e.g. Australia/Melbourne, America/New_York).

schedule.title: Schedule (cron)
schedule.description: When to generate Wrapped automatically. Default: 06:00 on 1 December. Leave empty to disable.

generateOnLoad.title: Generate now
generateOnLoad.description: Generate Wrapped shortly after the plugin is loaded or its settings are saved. Turn on and save to run it right away.

minPlays.title: Minimum plays
minPlays.description: Users with fewer plays than this in the year are skipped.

createPlaylist.title: Create Top Songs playlist
createPlaylist.description: Create (or replace) a private 'Wrapped <year> · Top Songs' playlist for each user.

playlistSize.title: Playlist size
playlistSize.description: Number of tracks in the Top Songs playlist.

embedArtwork.title: Embed artwork in story pages
embedArtwork.description: Embed album and artist images in the HTML story pages so they work as standalone files.

users.reason: Generate a Wrapped for each user you allow this plugin to access

scrobbleRetriever.reason: Read each user's play history for the year

subsonicapi.reason: Look up track details, fetch cover art and create the Top Songs playlist

scheduler.reason: Run the yearly Wrapped generation on a schedule

kvstore.reason: Remember generated playlist IDs and the last run summary

storage.reason: Write the per-user Wrapped story pages and JSON stats
